The '''Brink of the Celestial Wake''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and was apparently abandoned during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. A task force of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was stationed on the Brink, though the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Unidentified Jedi (Brink of the Celestial Wake)|in charge]] and all his [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] were [[Mission to the Brink of the Celestial Wake|slaughtered]] by strange [[pink blob]]s.

[[File:Pink_blobs.jpg|thumb|left|180px|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Serra Keto]] fighting [[pink blob]]s in the station.]]
While in the area, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] discovered a single humanoid signal from the Brink; it would turn out to be that of [[Serra Keto]], who had managed to survive on the station. Anakin rigged the station to detonate as soon as he and Serra made it out of the hangar bay.
